tagline.en: A novel-view synthesis model that generates high-fidelity new camera views from one or a few images, combining point-cloud geometry with video diffusion.
tagline.zh: 一个新视角合成模型,从单张或少量图像生成高保真的新相机视角,把点云几何与视频扩散结合起来。

en: ViewCrafter is a novel-view synthesis model: give it one or a few images of a scene, and it renders plausible new viewpoints along a camera path. It combines point-cloud geometry — recovered with a DUSt3R-style reconstruction — with a video diffusion model, so the generated views stay geometrically consistent while filling in unseen detail.

It ships as code and weights, with several checkpoints for different frame counts, resolutions, and sparse-view settings, letting you match the model to how many input views you have and the output length you want.
In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered; the checkpoints and the DUSt3R/view assets are staged separately, and the runtime lists what it needs before generating.
zh: ViewCrafter 是一个新视角合成模型:给它一张或几张场景图像,它就能沿相机路径渲染出合理的新视角。它把点云几何——由 DUSt3R 式重建恢复——与视频扩散模型结合起来,使生成的视角在几何上保持一致,同时补全未见的细节。
它以代码加权重形式发布,提供多个 checkpoint,对应不同的帧数、分辨率与稀疏视角设置,方便你按输入视角数量和期望的输出长度来匹配模型。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册;checkpoint 以及 DUSt3R/视角素材需另行准备,运行时会在生成前列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Use ViewCrafter when you want to synthesize new camera views from limited images — for example generating an orbit or fly-through from a single photo or a sparse set of views.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从有限图像合成新的相机视角时,适合使用 ViewCrafter——例如从一张照片或稀疏视角生成环绕或穿行镜头。

notFor.en: It focuses on view synthesis from images rather than text-to-video, and it depends on staged DUSt3R and checkpoint assets to run.
notFor.zh: 它专注于从图像做视角合成,而非文生视频,且运行依赖已准备好的 DUSt3R 与 checkpoint 素材。
